column1: # Slovak diacritic-fold table (D-450) - base letter -> every real accented variant, so a token typed without
# its diacritic still reaches the correctly-spelled word. hints.tsv (same folder) picks one representative
# symbol per key for the AltGr long-press hint; this file keeps the complete set per base letter - a/o/l host
# two real, distinct Slovak letters each (á/ä, ó/ô, l/ĺ - the long-vowel/syllabic-consonant pairs).
